entities.summary: Joseph Zacharie Jacques Apoux was a French painter, illustrator and engraver of the late 19th century associated with the Decadent movement. Joseph Apoux was a painters & sculptors from Le Blanc (1846-11-05, Le Blanc–1910-11-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
